name: InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort
description: One of Queensland's most prestigious resort hotels — the InterContinental Sanctuary Cove is a magnificent tropical resort set around a stunning marina and golf course, 15 minutes from Dreamworld. Featuring elegant rooms, multiple restaurants, a lagoon pool, full spa and watersports. The finest luxury hotel experience near Dreamworld Gold Coast.

rooms.description: Elegant tropical room with garden or marina views, free WiFi.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with panoramic marina views and breakfast.

name: TRYP by Wyndham Gold Coast
description: A modern and stylish 4-star hotel in Southport, 15 minutes from Dreamworld — offering contemporary rooms, a rooftop pool and bar with Gold Coast views, gym and excellent access to Dreamworld and all Gold Coast theme parks. One of the most popular and well-rated hotels for Gold Coast theme park visitors.

name: BIG4 Gold Coast Holiday Park
description: A popular and family-friendly holiday park 10 minutes from Dreamworld — offering comfortable cabin accommodation, powered sites, a pool, jumping pillow and playground facilities. The most family-friendly and budget-conscious accommodation option for visiting Dreamworld on the Gold Coast.
